releaseNotes:
v4.0.1: Firestick D-pad and stability deep-dive patch.

🔧 INPUT & FOCUS FIXES:
• Movies category rail: OK/Center now correctly selects and enters the chosen category
• Series category rail: OK/Center and Right now consistently select + enter
• Removed ghost hot-pink focus state that stayed on first items in Movies, Series, Live TV, and Guide
• Guide row highlight alignment corrected so row focus no longer appears one line off

🎞️ PLAYER & SUBTITLE FIXES:
• Subtitle picker off-by-one fixed (selecting a subtitle now picks the exact highlighted track)
• Unified subtitle list mapping between UI rows and Enter-key selection
• Added extra null-safe media initialization guards to prevent playback crashes

📺 SERIES INFO UPGRADE:
• Series detail panel now uses a richer movie-info style hero layout
• Added backdrop hero, metadata badges (rating/year/genre/runtime), and director/cast display

🛡️ CRASH HARDENING:
• Added safe navigation guard against duplicate remote enter presses
• Added additional DAO/network exception guards in Movies/Series detail flows
• Background thread uncaught exceptions are now isolated to avoid whole-app process kills
